headline:
What Sellers *Asked*
vs. What Buyers *Paid*
asof: Henry County · figures as of September 10, 2026
titan_line: Hey Echo, look at these two side by side. As of September 10, the median asking price around here was **$375,000**. The median sold price was **$334,000**.
checks_rows: Homes took about **59 days** to sell — roughly two months
About **1,340 homes** were for sale across the county
echo_line: Median? …Oh — the middle one. Half above, half below. Okay, so the asking price isn't the real price. I'd check what sold nearby.
source: Redfin & Zillow · Henry County, GA · retrieved September 10, 2026
disclaimer: County-wide figures for that date only. Not an appraisal, a valuation, or a prediction for any individual property.
